Cone volume 48π cm³ and radius 4 cm. Find height (cm).
Cone volume 75π cm³ and height 9 cm. Find radius (cm).
practice.solution: 75=r²×9/3=3r², so r²=25 and positive r=5 cm.

A cone radius 3 cm, height 4 cm is enlarged by factor 2 in every dimension. Find coefficient of π in new volume (cm³).
practice.solution: Original volume=12π; volume scales by 2³=8; new volume=96π cm³.

practice.prompt: Cone volume 72π cm³ and height 6 cm. Find radius (cm).
Right cone radius 6 cm and curved area 60π cm². Find perpendicular height (cm).
practice.solution: Curved area=πrl gives l=60/6=10; h=√(l²−r²)=√(100−36)=8 cm.
